services.title: Bathroom Tiling
services.desc: Complete bathroom transformations including waterproofing, tile selection advice, and grout sealing. We handle wet rooms, shower enclosures, and feature walls.

services.title: Kitchen Splashbacks & Worktops
services.desc: Bespoke splashback tiling and tiled worktop installation. Durable, easy-clean finishes that match your kitchen design perfectly.

services.title: Floor Tiling
services.desc: Hard-wearing floor tiles for kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and commercial spaces. Properly bedded, grouted, and sealed for longevity.

services.title: Wall Tiling & Feature Walls
services.desc: Create a focal point with accent tiling, mosaic patterns, and decorative tile work. Every wall is prepared and finished to exacting standards.

services.title: Tile Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Cracked or loose tiles? We remove damaged tiles and replace them seamlessly, matching colour and pattern where possible.

services.title: Grout & Sealant Work
services.desc: Professional grout colour matching, deep cleaning, and waterproof sealant application. Protects your tiles and keeps them looking fresh.

about_pullquote: Every tile we lay is one we'd be proud to see in our own home.
about_para_1: Kyle Knowles Tiling has been serving Manchester homes and businesses for over 15 years. Founded on a simple principle — precision, reliability, and fair pricing — we've built a reputation for transforming spaces with beautiful tilework. From modest bathroom updates to large-scale commercial projects, we approach every job with the same meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave a clean site. We don't cut corners on preparation or grouting — two steps that separate mediocre tiling from work that lasts. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals, which tells you everything you need to know about our standard.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Kyle retiled our entire bathroom and fitted a new splashback in the kitchen. The quality of work is fantastic — the grouting is perfect and everything looks like it cost twice as much. He turned up on time, worked cleanly, and finished when he said he would. Can't recommend him highly enough.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a leaking ensuite that needed complete retiling. Kyle sorted the waterproofing properly and laid beautiful large-format tiles. He even helped me choose colours and explained why certain adhesives work better. Professional, friendly, and reasonably priced.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Tiled our kitchen floor and installed a feature wall in the lounge. The finish is immaculate and it's held up perfectly. Kyle was efficient, tidy, and gave us a fair quote without any hidden extras. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Paul W.
